verdict.rationale: Xero's developer portal advertises SDKs, and the official XeroAPI GitHub org hosts the xero-node SDK for JavaScript. Official OpenAPI specs are used to generate 'our new SDKs', and an AI Toolkit covers the OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain, so building against official SDKs is clearly supported. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of SDKs in languages beyond JavaScript (only implied by 'SDKs'), in-depth SDK documentation or maturity details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
